$doc: docs/DESIGN_Scenario_Regression.md §3 — CE-2223 air rescue round trip. Header Judge (1)-(5): lands at the LZ, squad dismounts, a man picks up the pilot, the pilot is seated aboard, all five men are back aboard, it lifts off with all aboard, pilot alive. TRIAGE (CE-4042): IsEmbarkedTag.Mode is NOT in the entity dump (the scenario translator writes only Vehicle + Seat), so 'carried' vs 'seated' cannot be read by Mode; the pilot being picked up = IsEmbarkedTag.Seat >= 0 (the tag exists), seated aboard = the UH-60's PassengerBuffer.Count == 10 (it carries 4 crew of its own: 9 at the start, 4 with the squad out). 'Lifts off' = the UH-60 leaves for its route's last waypoint (20, 390): x < 150 after the pilot is seated (NavigationStatus.Phase TakingOff already shows at 24 s, a hop to the Pickup waypoint, so it cannot mark the lift-off). Measured: picked up 31.75 s, 10 aboard 44.25 s, x < 120 at 68.25 s. Not expressible: who carries him (the Vehicle ref is an entity handle, not a name).
